name: Inis Glora

attributes.attribute: the last of three places to which the enchanted Children of Lir were condemned
a small island off the west coast of County Mayo

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Inis Glora is an Irish mythological site. It is the last of three places to which the enchanted Children of Lir were condemned. The island now called Inish Glora is small. It lies off the west coast of County Mayo.

okr.objective: Document the Irish mythological site Inis Glora.
key_results: Record Inis Glora as the last of the three places of the Children of Lir's exile.
Locate Inish Glora as a small island off the west coast of County Mayo.
